verdict.rationale: Oyster is a global payroll and EOR platform, so a fast direct-deposit story applies to it. The evidence only says it offers "multi-country payroll in 120+ currencies" and lets you "send payments" to freelancers. Nothing documents direct deposit as the payment method or any next-day or 2-day payout speed. The "48 hours" claim refers to onboarding, not payment timing, so it does not count toward this story.
